messages:
morgan: midweek experiment 1 need a 3-song couch nap mini-playlist that always works. only rules: under 20 min total, low energy preferred. drop picks pls :zzz:

tess: hey morgan 1 try this microlist: 1) Nils Frahm - Says 2) Hammock - Turn Away and Return 3) Goldmund - Threnody. soft, instrumental, very nap-friendly.

ramesh: i like adding a soft vocal to end so you don't wake up startled. suggestion: Radiohead - Codex as a closer.

jun: vote: Loop whole 3-song sequence or play once and let it fade?

sam: loop and gentle crossfade. set phone to do-not-disturb.

ava: posting a tiny playlist (public): ```1) Nils Frahm - Says
2) d3lafur Arnalds - Near Light
3) Bing & Ruth - Starwood Choker``` link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX2yvmlOdMYzV (backup public playlist)

morgan: amazing, thanks! Plan: couch test tonight at 9pm, looping w/ 6s crossfade. will report results.

spike-bot: Reminder: keep shared-space volumes < 60%. Be considerate. :robot_face:

jun: anecdote: once slept through a 2hr thunderstorm with Nils Frahm on repeat. 10/10 for nap resilience.

sam: post-nap movie recs for low-key evening: Paterson, Before Sunrise, Lost in Translation.

ramesh: or a short book: Raymond Carver short stories are great for that hazy post-nap mood.

morgan: will test tonight and share verdicts (sleep duration + whether i dreamt of tacos). thanks everyone :thumbsup:
